verses: Alif Laam Ra. Yeh pur-hikmat kitab ki aayaten hain

Kiya unn logon ko uss baat say tajjub hua kay hum ney unn mein say aik shakhs kay pass wahee bhej di kay sab aadmiyon ko daraiye aur jo eman ley aaye unn ko yeh khushkhabri sunaiye kay unn kay rab kay pass unn ko poora ajar o martaba milay ga. Kafiron ney kaha kay yeh shakhs to bila-shuba sareeh jadoogar hai

Bila-shuba tumhara rab Allah hi hai jiss ney aasmano aur zamin ko chhe roz mein peda kerdiya phir arsh per qaeem hua woh her kaam ki tadbeer kerta hai. Uss ki ijazat kay baghair koi uss kay pass sifarish kerney wala nahi aisa Allah tumhara rab hai so tum uss ki ibadat kero, kiya tum phir bhi naseehat nahi pakartay

Tum sab ko Allah hi kay pass jana hai, Allah ney sacha wada ker rakha hai. Be-shak o hi pehli baar bhi peda kerta hai phir o hi doobara bhi peda keray ga takay aisay logon ko jo kay eman laye aur unhon ney nek kaam kiye insaf kay sath jaza dey aur jin logon ney kufur kiya unn kay wastay kholta hua pani peenay ko milay ga aur dard-naak azab hoga unn kay kufur ki wajah say

Woh Allah Taalaa aisa hai jiss ney aftab ko chamakta hua banaya aur chand ko noorani banaya aur uss kay liye manzilen muqarrar kin takay tum barson ki ginti aur hisab maloom kerliya kero. Allah Taalaa ney yeh cheezen bey faeedah nahi peda kin. Woh yeh dalaeel unn ko saaf saaf batla raha hai jo danish rakhtay hain

Bila-shuba raat aur din kay yakay baad deegray aaney mein aur Allah Taalaa ney jo kuch aasmano aur zamin mein peda kiya hai unn sab mein unn logon kay wastay dalaeel hain jo Allah ka darr rakhtay hain
Jin logon ko humaray pass aaney ka yaqeen nahi hai aur woh dunyawi zindagi per razi hogaye hain aur uss mein ji laga bethay hain aur jo log humari aayaton say ghafil hain
Aisay logon ka thikana unn kay aemaal ki wajah say dozakh hai
Yaqeenan jo log eman laye aur unhon ney nek kaam kiye unn ka rab unn ko unn kay eman kay sabab unn kay maqsad tak phoncha dey ga nemat kay baghon mein jin kay neechay nehren jari hun gi
Unn kay mun say yeh baat niklay gi subhan Allah aur unn ka bahumi salam yeh hoga as-salam alaikum aur unn ki akheer baat yeh hogi tamam tareefen Allah kay liye hain jo saray jahaan ka rab hai

Aur agar Allah logon per jaldi say nuksan waqey kerdiya kerta jiss tarah woh faeedah kay liye jaldi machatay hain to unn ka wada kabhi ka poora chuka hota. So hum unn logon ko jin ko humaray pass aaney ka yaqeen nahi hai unn kay haal per choray rakhtay hain kay apni sirkashi mein bhataktay rahen

Aur jab insan ko koi takleef phonchti hai to hum ko pukarta hai letay bhi, bethay bhi, kharay bhi. Phir jab hum uss ki takleef uss say hata detay hain to woh aisa hojata hai kay goya uss ney apni takleef kay liye jo ussay phonchi thi kabhi humen pukara hi na tha, unn hadd say guzarney walon kay aemaal ko unn kay liye ussi tarah khushnuma banadiya gaya hai

Aur hum ney tum say pehlay boht say girohon ko halak kerdiya jab kay unhon ney zulm kiya halankay unn kay pass unn kay payghumbar bhi dalaeel ley ker aaye, aur woh aisay kab thay kay eman ley aatay? Hum mujrim logon ko aisi hi saza diya kertay hain
Phir unn kay baad hum ney duniya mein bajaye unn kay tum ko janasheen kiya takay hum dekh len kay tum kiss tarah kaam kertay ho

Aur jab unn kay samney humari aayaten parhi jati hain jo bilkul saaf saaf hain to yeh log jin ko humaray pass aaney ki umeed nahi hai yun kehtay hain kay uss kay siwa koi doosra Quran layiye ya uss mein kuch tarmeem ker dijiye. Aap (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) yun keh dijiye kay mujhay yeh haq nahi kay mein apni taraf say uss mein tarmeem kerdoon bus mein to ussi ka ittabaa keroon ga jo meray pass wahee kay zariye say phoncha hai, agar mein apney rab ki na-farmani keroon to mein aik baray din kay azab ka andesha rakhta hun

Aap yun keh dijiye kay agar Allah ko manzoor hota to na to mein tum ko woh parh ker sunata aur na Allah Taalaa tum ko uss ki itlaa deta kyunkay mein uss say pehlay to aik baray hissa umar tak tum mein reh chuka hun. Phir kiya tum aqal nahi rakhtay
So uss shakhs say ziyadah kaun zalim hoga jo Allah jhoot bandhay ya uss ki aayaton ko jhoota batlaye, yaqeenan aisay mujrimon ko aslan falah na hogi

Aur yeh log Allah kay siwa aisi cheezon ki ibadat kertay hain jo na unn ko zarar phoncha saken aur na unn ko nafa phoncha saken aur kehtay hain kay yeh Allah kay pass humaray sifarshi hain. Aap keh dijiye kay kiya tum Allah ko aisi cheez ki khabar detay ho jo Allah Taalaa ko maloom nahi, na aasmano mein aur na zamin mein, woh pak aur bartar hai unn logon kay shirk say

Aur tamam log aik hi ummat kay thay phir unhon ney ikhtilaf peda ker liya aur agar aik baat na hoti jo aap kay rab ki taraf say pehlay thehar chuki hai to jiss cheez mein yeh log ikhtilaf rahey hain unn ka qataee faisla chuka hota

Aur yeh log yun kehtay hain kay unn per unn kay rab ki janib say koi nishani kiyon nahi nazil hoti? So aap farma dijiye kay ghaib ki khabar sirf Allah ko hai so tum bhi muntazir raho mein bhi tumharay sath muntazir hun

Aur jab hum logon ko uss amar kay baad kay unn per koi museebat parr chuki ho kissi nemat ka maza chakha detay hain to woh foran hi humari aayaton kay baray mein chalen chalney lagtay hain, aap keh dijiye kay Allah chaal chalney mein tum say ziyadah tez hai, bil-yaqeen humaray farishtay tumhari sab chaalon ko likh rahey hain

Woh Allah aisa hai kay tum ko khushki aur darya mein chalata hai, yahan tak kay jab tum kashti mein hotay ho aur woh kashtiyan logon ko moafiq hua kay zariye say ley ker chalti hain aur woh log unn say khush hotay hain unn per aik jhonka sakht hua ka aata hai aur her taraf say unn per mojen uthti chali aati hain aur woh samajhtay hain kay (buray) aa ghiray, (uss waqt) sab khalis aetiqaad kerkay Allah hi ko pukartay hain kay agar to hum ko uss say bacha to hum zaroor shukar guzaar bann jayen gay

Phir jab Allah Taalaa unn ko bacha leta hai to foran hi woh zamin mein na-haq sirkashi kerney lagtay hain aey logo! yeh tumhari sirkashi tumharay liye wabaal honey wali hai dunyawi zindagi kay (chand) faeeday hain, phir humaray pass tum ko aana hai phir hum sab tumhara kiya hua tum ko batla gay

Pus dunyawi zindagi ki halat to aisi hai jaisay hum ney aasman say pani barsaya phir uss say zamin ki nabataat, jin ko aadmi aur chopaye khatay hain, khoob gunjaan hoker nikli. Yahan tak kay jab woh zamin apni ronaq ka poora hissa ley chuki aur uss ki khoob zebaeesh hogaee aur uss kay maalikon ney samajh liya kay abb hum uss per bilkul qabiz chukay to din mein ya raat mein uss per humari taraf say koi hukum (azab) para so hum ney uss ko aisa saaf kerdiya kay goya kul woh mojood hi na thi. Hum ussi tarah aayaat ko saaf saaf biyan kertay hain aisay logon kay liye jo sochtay hain
Aur Allah Taalaa salamti kay ghar ki taraf tum ko bulata hai aur jiss ko chahata hai raah raast per chalney ki tofiq deta hai
Jin logon ney neki ki hai unn kay wastay khoobi hai aur mazeed baran bhi aur unn kay chehron per na siyahi chaye gi aur na zillat, yeh log jannat mein rehney walay hain woh uss mein hamesha rahen gay

Aur jin logon ney bad-kaam kiye unn ki badi ki saza uss kay barabar milay gi aur unn ko zillat chaye gi, unn ko Allah Taalaa say koi na bacha sakay ga. Goya unn kay chehron per andheri raat kay parat kay parat lapet diye gaye hain. Yeh log dozakh mein rehney walay hain, woh uss mein hamesha rahen gay

Aur woh din bhi qabil zikar hai jiss roz hum unn sab ko jama keren gay phir mushrikeen say kahen gay kay tum aur tumharay shareek apni jagah thehro phir hum unn kay aapas mein phoot daal den gay aur unn kay woh shurka kahen gay kay tum humari ibadat nahi kertay thay
So humaray tumharay darmiyan Allah kafi hai gawah kay tor per, kay hum ko tumhari ibadat ki khabar bhi na thi

Uss muqam per her shakhs apney aglay kiye huye kaamon ki jaanch kerley ga aur yeh log Allah ki taraf jo unn ka malik haqeeqi hai lotaye jayen gay aur jo kuch jhoot bandha kertay thay sab unn say ghaeeb hojayen gay

Aap kahiye kay woh kaun hai jo tum ko aasman aur zamin say rizq phonchata hai ya woh kaun hai jo kanon aur aankhon per poora ikhtiyar rakhta hai aur woh kaun hai jo zindah ko murdah say nikalta hai aur murdah ko zindah say nikalta hai aur woh kaun hai jo tamam kaamon ki tadbeer kerta hai? Zaroor woh yehi kahen gay kay Allah to unn say kahiye kay phir kiyon nahi dartay
So yeh hai Allah Taalaa jo tumhara rab haqeeqi hai. Phir haq kay baad aur kiya reh gaya ba-juz gumrahi kay, phir kahan phiray jatay ho?
Ussi tarah aap kay rab ki yeh baat kay yeh eman na layen gay, tamam fasiq logon kay haq mein sabit hochuki hai

Aap yun kahiye kay kiya tumharay shurka mein koi aisa hai jo pehli baar bhi peda keray, phir doobara bhi peda keray? Aap keh dijiye kay Allah hi pehli baar peda kerta hai phir o hi doobara bhi peda keray ga. Phir tum kahan phiray jatay ho?

Aap kahiye kay tumharay shurka mein koi aisa hai kay haq ka raasta batata ho? Aap keh dijiye kay Allah hi haq ka raasta batata hai. To phir aaya jo shakhs haq ka raasta batata ho woh ziyadah ittabaa kay laeeq hai ya woh shakhs jiss ko baghair bataye khud hi raasta na soojhay? Pus tum ko kiya hogaya hai tum kaisay faislay kertay ho
Aur unn mein say aksar log sirf guman per chal rahey hain. Yaqeenan guman, haq (ki maarfat) mein kuch bhi kaam nahi dey sakta yeh jo kuch rahey hain yaqeenan Allah ko sab khabar hai

Aur yeh Quran aisa nahi hai kay Allah (ki wahee) kay baghair (apney hi say) gharr liya gaya ho. Balkay)yeh yeh to (unn kitabon ki) tasdeeq kerney wala hai jo uss kay qabal (nazil) hochuki hain aur kitab (ehkaam zarooriya) ki tafseel biyan kerney wala hai uss mein koi baat shak ki nahi kay rab aalameen ki taraf say hai
Kiya yeh log yun kehtay hain kay aap ney uss ko gharr liya hai? Aap keh dijiye kay to phir tum uss kay misil aik hi surat lao aur jin jin ghair-Allah ko bula sako, bula lo agar tum sachay ho

Balkay)yeh aisi cheez ki takzeeb kerney lagay jiss ko apney ehaata ilmi mein nahi laye aur hanoz unn ko uss ka akheer nateeja nahi mila. Jo log unn say pehlay huye hain ussi tarah unhon ney bhi jhutlaya tha, so dekh lijiye unn zalimon ka anjam kaisa hua?
Aur unn mein say baaz aisay hain jo uss per eman ley aayen gay aur baaz aisay hain kay uss per eman na layen gay. Aur aap ka rab mufisdon ko khoob janta hai
Aur agar aap ko jhutlatay rahen to yeh keh dijiye kay meray liye mera amal aur tumharay liye tumhara amal, tum meray amal say buri ho aur mein tumharay amal say buri hun
Aur unn mein baaz aisay hain jo aap ki taraf kaan lagaye bethay hain. Kiya aap behron ko sunatay hain go unn ko samajh bhi na ho?
Aur unn mein baaz aisay hain kay aap ko tak rahey hain. Phir kiya aap andhon ko raasta dikhlana chahatay hain go unn ko baseerat bhi na ho?
Yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay Allah logon per kuch zulm nahi kerta lekin log khud hi apni janon per zulm kertay hain

Aur unn ko woh din yaad dulaiye jiss mein Allah unn ko (apney huzoor) jama keray ga (to unn ko aisa mehsoos hoga) kay goya woh (duniya mein) saray din ki aik aadh ghari rahey hun gay aur aapas mein aik doosray ko pehchanney ko thehray hun gay. Waqaee khasaray mein paray woh log jinhon ney Allah kay pass janey ko jhutlaya aur woh hidayat paney walay na thay

Aur jiss ka unn say hum wada ker rahey hain uss mein say kuch thora sa agar hum aap ko dikhla den ya (unn kay zahoor say pehlay) hum aap ko wafat dey den, so humaray pass to unn ko aana hi hai. Phir Allah unn kay sab afaal per gawah hai
Aur her ummat kay liye aik rasool hai, so jab unn ka woh rasool chukta hai unn ka faisla insaf kay sath kiya jata hai, aur unn per zulm nahi kiya jata
Aur yeh log kehtay hain kay yeh wada kab hoga? Agar tum sachay ho

Aap farma dijiye kay mein apni zaat kay liye to kissi nafa ka aur kissi zarar ka ikhtiyar rakhta hi nahi magar jitna Allah ko manzoor ho. Her ummat kay liye aik moyyen waqt hai jab unn ka woh moyyen waqt phonchta hai to aik ghari na peechay hatt saktay hain aur na aagay sirak saktay hain
Aap farma dijiye kay yeh to batlao kay agar tum per Allah ka azab raat ko paray ya din ko to azab mein kaun si cheez aisi hai kay mujrim log uss ko jaldi maang rahey hain
Kiya phir jab woh hi paray ga uss per eman lao gay. Haan abb mana! halankay tum uss ki jaldi machaya kertay thay
Phir zalimon say kaha jaye ga kay hamesha ka azab chakho. Tum ko to tumharay kiye ka hi badla mila hai
Aur woh aap say daryaft kertay hain kay kiya azab waqaee sach hai? Aap farma dijiye kay haan qasam hai meray rab ki woh waqaee sach hai aur tum kissi tarah Allah ko aajiz nahi saktay

Aur agar her jaan, jiss ney zulm (shirk) kiya hai, kay pass itna ho kay sari zamin bhar jaye tab bhi uss ko dey ker apni jaan bachaney lagay aur jab azab ko dekhen gay to pasheymani ko posheedah rakhen gay. Aur unn ka faisla insaf kay sath hoga. Aur unn per zulm na hoga
Yaad rakho kay jitni cheezen aasmano mein aur zamin mein hain sab Allah hi ki mulk hain. Yaad rakho kay Allah Taalaa ka wada sacha hai lekin boht say aadmi ilm hi nahi rakhtay
O hi jaan dalta hai o hi jaan nikalta hai aur tum sab ussi kay pass laye jao gay

Aey logo! tumharay pass tumharay rab ki taraf say aik aisi cheez aaee hai jo naseehat hai aur dilon mein jo rog hain unn kay liye shifa hai aur rehnumaee kerney wali hai aur rehmat hai eman walon kay liye
Aap keh dijiye kay bus logon ko Allah kay uss inam aur rehmat per khush hona chahaiye. Woh uss say ba-darjaha behtar hai jiss ko woh jama ker rahey hain

Aap kahiye kay yeh to batao kay Allah ney tumharay liye jo kuch rizq bheja tha phir tum ney uss ka kuch hissa haram aur kuch halal qarar dey liya. Aap poochiye kay kiya tum ko Allah ney hukum diya tha ya Allah per iftra hi kertay ho?
Aur jo log Allah per jhoot iftra bandhtay hain unn ka qayamat ki nisbat kiya guman hai? Waqaee logon per Allah Taalaa ka bara hi fazal hai lekin aksar aadmi shukar nahi kertay

Aur aap kissi haal mein hun aur munjmila unn ehwaal kay aap kahen say Quran parhtay hun aur jo kaam bhi kertay hun hum ko sab ki khabar rehti hai jab tum uss kaam mein mashghool hotay ho. Aur aap kay rab say koi cheez zarra barabar bhi ghaeeb nahi na zamin mein aur na aasman mein aur na koi cheez uss say choti aur na koi cheez bari magar yeh sab kitab mubeen mein hai
Yaad rakho Allah kay doston per na koi andesha hai aur na woh ghumgeen hotay hain
Yeh woh log hain jo eman laye aur (buraiyon say) perhez rakhtay hain
Unn kay liye dunyawi zindagi mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi khush khabri hai Allah Taalaa ki baaton mein kuch farq hua nahi kerta. Yeh bari kaamyabi hai
Aur aap ko unn ki baaten ghum mein na dalen. Tamam tar ghalba Allah hi kay liye hai woh sunta janta hai

Yaad rakho kay jitney kuch aasmano mein hain aur jitney zamin mein hain yeh sab Allah hi kay hain aur jo log Allah ko chor ker doosray shurka ki ibadat rahey hain kiss cheez ki ittabaa ker rahey hain. Mehaz bey sanad khayal ki ittabaa ker rahey hain aur mehaz atkalen laga rahey hain

Woh aisa hai jiss ney tumharay liye raat banaee takay tum uss mein aaram kero aur din bhi uss tor per banaya kay dekhney bhalney ka zariye hai, tehqeeq uss mein dalaeel hain unn logon kay liye jo suntay hain

Woh kehtay hain kay Allah aulad rakhta hai. Subhan Allah! woh to kissi ka mohtaj nahi ussi ki milkiyat hai jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zamin mein hai. Tumharay pass uss per koi daleel nahi. Kiya Allah kay zimmay aisi baat lagatay ho jiss ka tum ilm nahi rakhtay
Aap keh dijiye kay jo log Allah per jhoot iftra kertay hain, woh kaamyaab na hun gay
Yeh duniya mein thora sa aish hai phir humaray pass unn ko aana hai phir hum unn ko unn kay kufur kay badlay sakht azab chakhayen gay

Aur aap unn ko Nooh) alaihi as-salam (ka qissa parh ker sunaiye jab kay unhon ney apni qom say farmaya kay aey meri qom! agar tum ko mera rehna aur ehkaam elahi ki naseehat kerna bhari maloom hota hai to mera to Allah hi per bharosa hai. Tum apni tadbeer maaye apney shurka kay pukhta kerlo phir tumhari tadbeer tumhari ghuttan ka baees na honi chahaiye. Phir meray sath ker guzro aur mujh ko mohlat na do
Phir bhi agar tum aeyraaz hi kiye jao to mein ney tum say koi maawza to nahi maanga, mera maawza to sirf Allah hi kay zimmay hai aur mujh ko hukum kiya gaya hai kay mein musalmanon mein say rahon

So woh log unn ko jhutlatay rahey pus hum ney unn ko aur jo unn kay sath kashti mein thay unn ko nijat di aur unn ko janasheen banaya aur jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya tha unn ko gharq kerdiya. So dekhna chahaiye kaisa anjam hua unn logon ka jo daraye chukay thay

Phir Nooh (alaihi as-salam) kay baad hum ney aur rasoolon ko unn ki qomon ki taraf bheja so woh unn kay pass roshan daleelen ley ker aaye pus jiss cheez ko unhon ney awwal mein jhoota keh diya yeh na hua kay phir uss ko maan letay. Allah Taalaa ussi tarah hadd say barhney walon kay dilon per band laga deta hai

Phir unn payghumbaron kay baad hum ney Musa aur Haroon (alaihima as-salam) ko, Firaun aur uss kay sardaron kay pass apni nishaniyan dey ker bheja. So unhon ney takabbur kiya aur woh log mujrim qom thay
Phir jab unn ko humaray pass say sahih daleel phonchi to woh log kehney lagay kay yaqeenan yeh sareeh jadoo hai
Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney farmaya kay kiya tum uss sahih daleel ki nisbat jab kay woh tumharay pass phonchi aisi baat kehtay ho kiya yeh jadoo hai, halankay jadoogar kaamyaab nahi hua kertay

Woh log kehney lagay kiya tum humaray pass uss liye aaye ho kay hum ko uss tareeqa say hata jiss per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya hai aur tum dono ko duniya mein baraee mill jaye aur hum tum dono ko kabhi na manen gay
Aur Firaun ney kaha kay meray pass tamam maahir jadoogaron ko hazir kero
Phir jab jadoogar aaye to Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney unn say farmaya kay dalo jo kuch tum dalney walay ho

So jab unhon ney dala to Musa) alaihi as-salam (ney farmaya kay yeh jo kuch tum laye ho jadoo hai. Yaqeeni baat hai kay Allah uss ko abhi darhum barhum kiye deta hai, Allah aisay fasadiyon ka kaam bannay nahi deta
Aur Allah Taalaa haq ko apney farman say sabit ker deta hai go mujrim kaisa hi nagawaar samjhen

Pus Musa (alaihi as-salam) per unn ki qom mein say sirf qadray qaleel aadmi eman laye woh bhi Firaun say aur apney hukkaam say dartay dartay kay kahen unn ko takleef phonchaye aur waqey mein Firaun uss mulk mein zor rakhta tha, aur yeh bhi baat thi kay woh hadd say bahir ho jata tha
Aur Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney farmaya kay aey meri qom! agar tum Allah per eman rakhtay ho to ussi per tawakkal kero agar tum musalman ho
Unhon ney arz kiya kay hum ney Allah hi per tawakkal kiya. Aey humaray perwerdigar! hum ko unn zalimon kay liye fitna na bana
Aur hum ko apni rehmat say unn kafir logon say nijat dey

Aur hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) aur unn kay bhai kay pass wahee bheji kay tum dono apney unn logon kay liye misir mein ghar bar-qarar rakho aur tum sab apney unhi gharon ko namaz parhney ki jagah qarar dey lo aur namaz kay paband raho aur aap musalmanon ko bisharat dey den

Aur Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney arz kiya aey humaray rab! tu ney Firaun ko aur uss kay sardaron ko saman zeenat aur tarah tarah kay maal dunyawi zindagi mein diye. Aey humaray rab! (ussi wastay diye hain kay) woh teri raah say gumrah keren. Aey humaray rab! unn kay maalon ko neest o nabood ker dey aur unn kay dilon ko sakht kerdey so yeh eman na laney payen yahan tak kay dard-naak azab ko dekh len
Haq Taalaa ney farmaya kay tum dono ki dua qabool kerli gaee, so tum sabit qadam raho aur unn logon ki raah na chalna jin ko ilm nahi

Aur hum ney bani israeel ko darya say paar kerdiya phir unn kay peechay peechay Firaun apney lashkar kay sath zulm aur ziyadti kay iradah say chala yahan tak kay jab dobney laga to kehney laga kay mein eman laata hun kay jiss per bani israeel eman laye hain, uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi aur mein musalmanon mein say hun
(jawab diya gaya kay) abb eman laata hai? Aur pehlay sirkashi kerta raha aur mufisdon mein dakhil raha
So aaj hum sirf teri laash ko nijat den gay takay to unn kay liye nishan ibrat ho jo teray baad hain aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay boht say aadmi humari nishaniyon say ghafil hain

Aur hum ney bani israeel ko boht acha thikana rehney ko diya aur hum ney unhen pakeezah cheezen khaney ko den. So unhon ney ikhtilaf nahi kiya yahan tak kay unn kay pass ilm phonch gaya. Yaqeeni baat hai kay aap ka rab unn kay darmiyan qayamat kay din unn umoor mein faisla keray ga jin mein woh ikhtilaf kertay thay

Phir agar aap uss ki taraf say shak mein hun jiss ko hum ney aap kay pass bheja hai to aap unn logon say pooch dekhiye jo aap say pehli kitabon ko parhtay hain. Be-shak aap kay pass aap kay rab ki taraf say sachi kitab aaee hai. Aap hergiz shak kerney walon mein say na hun
Aur na unn logon mein say hun jinhon ney Allah Taalaa ki aayaton ko jhutlaya, kahen aap khasarah paney walon mein say na hojayen
Yaqeenan jin logon kay haq mein aap kay rab ki baat sabit hochuki hai woh eman na layen gay
Go unn kay pass tamam nishaniyan phonch jayen jab tak kay woh dard-naak azab ko na dekh len

Chunacha koi basti eman na laee kay eman lana uss ko naafay hota siwaye Yunus) alaihi as-salam (ki qom kay. Jab woh eman ley aaye to hum ney ruswaee kay azab ko dunyawi zindagi mein unn per say taal diya aur unn ko aik waqt (khaas) tak kay liye zindagi say faeedah uthaney (ka moqay) diya
Aur agar aap ka rab chahata to tamam aur zamin kay log sab kay sab eman ley aatay, to kiya aap logon per zabardasti saktay hain yahan tak kay woh momin hi hojayen
Halankay kissi shakhs ka eman lana Allah kay hukum kay baghair mumkin nahi. Aur Allah Taalaa bey aqal logon per gandagi daal deta hai
Aap keh dijiye kay tum ghor kero kay kiya kiya cheezen aasmano mein aur zamin mein hain aur jo log eman nahi latay unn ko nishaniyan aur dhamkiyan kuch faeedah nahi phonchatin

So woh log sirf unn logon kay say waqiyaat ka intizar ker rahey hain jo unn say pehlay guzar chukay hain. Aap farma dijiye kay acha to tum intizar mein raho mein bhi tumharay sath intizar kerney walon mein hun
Phir hum apney payghumbaron ko aur eman walon ko bacha letay thay, ussi tarah humaray zimmay hai kay hum eman walon ko nijat diya kertay hain

Aap keh dijiye kay aey logo! agar tum maray deen ki taraf say shak mein ho to mein unn maboodon ki ibadat nahi kerta jin ki tum Allah ko chor ker ibadat kertay ho, lekin haan uss Allah ki ibadat kerta hun jo tumhari jaan qabz kerta hai. Aur mujh ko yeh hukum hua hai kay mein eman laney walon mein say hun
Aur yeh kay apna rukh yaksoo ho ker (uss) deen ki taraf ker lena, aur kabhi mushrikon mein say na hona
Aur Allah ko chor ker aisi cheez ki ibadat mat kerna jo tujh ko na koi nafa phoncha sakay aur na koi zarar phoncha sakay. Phir agar aisa kiya to tum uss halat mein zalimon mein say ho jao gay

Aur agar tum ko Allah koi takleef phonchaye to ba-juz uss kay aur koi uss ko door kerney wala nahi hai aur agar woh tum ko koi khair phonchana chahaye to uss kay fazal ka koi hataney wala nahi, woh apna fazal apney bandon mein say jiss per chahaye nichawar kerdey aur woh bari maghfirat bari rehmat wala hai

Aap keh dijiye kay aey logo! tumharay pass haq tumharay rab ki taraf say phonch chuka hai, uss liye jo shakhs raah raast per aajaye so woh apney wastay raah raast per aaye ga aur jo shakhs bey raah rahey ga to uss ka bey raah hona ussi per paray ga aur mein tum per musallat nahi kiya gaya
Aur aap uss ki ittabaa kertay rahiye jo kuch aap kay pass wahee bheji jati hai aur sabar kijiye yahan tak kay Allah faisla kerdey aur woh sab faisla kerney walon mein acha hai
